description: Everything about ONE app: its full config and state (features, and `modules`: the neblla.* modules it has; rooms, quota and credits today, subscription, the config shown is what is being edited: its pre with the unpublished draft over it; `draft` { count, files, settings, savedAt, dropped } is what waits for neblla_promote "publish" (dropped: the changes Neblla took out because they no longer fit), `env.target` where a publish goes ("pro", the default, or "pre"), `env.pro.promotedAt` when pro last changed; gallery, community, ai…), every URL it answers at (by id and slug on each Neblla host and its Cloudflare deploy), the custom domains registered (the allowed origins added with addDomain — Neblla does not serve the app at them, the developer does), whether a TURN relay is available for the P2P "media" option, and `suggestions`: settings off by default that the app's last 7 days (today and the 6 UTC days before) say would help ([{ id, data, change, pending, live }]; apply `change` with neblla_update_app: it waits in the draft and `pending` = already in the draft or in pre, only neblla_promote "publish" is missing; `live: true` (the moderation log) is the app's own setting, it goes to pro at once and is never pending; `suggestionsError` / `suggestionsFailed` say what could not be checked — an empty list then is not "nothing to suggest"), and `savesWaiting`: how many users have saves waiting in their browser ({ quota: refused for want of quota, they land on their next visit with quota; loop: saving in a loop the device refused }), and `alerts`: what needs the developer now, as the panel's Inicio says it ({ counts: { open, urgent, byTopic }, open: [{ id, type, urgent, title, what, users, todo }] }; history and who gets them: neblla_alerts), and `aiUsage`: what the app's AI spends (neblla.ai.prompt through Neblla and the community's AI check; the browser route never passes through Neblla): { today, month (this UTC month), last (the last 30 days), lifetime, ai, creditsPerCall }, each { calls (answered by the provider), tokensIn, tokensOut, refused (before the provider, no cost) and refusedBy { code: n }, failed (the provider answered an error) and failedBy, credits (what it cost the app's quota), dev / user / prescreen: the calls and tokens on the developer's key, on the users' own keys, and of the community check }. `legacy`, only for an app from before the SDK went by modules: { sdk: [{ name, use, files }] — calls of the old SDK in what the users have, which fail now (`use`: the new name; rewrite them, then neblla_promote "publish"), features: the modules its old switches mean (nothing breaks) }.
name: neblla_get_app
title: Get app
